description: This file contains SCSS mixins and functions related to responsive design breakpoints, defining media query utilities for different viewport sizes in a Bootstrap-based project.

methods.name: breakpoint-next
methods.description: Returns the name of the next breakpoint after the given one.

methods.name: breakpoint-min
methods.description: Returns the minimum width of a given breakpoint.

methods.name: breakpoint-max
methods.description: Returns the maximum width of a given breakpoint.

methods.name: breakpoint-infix
methods.description: Returns the infix string for a breakpoint, used for responsive utility naming.
